newsitem.title: UK: Claremont to close Glasgow factory, cut jobs.
newsitem.headline: Claremont to close Glasgow factory, cut jobs.

text.p: Clothing manufacturer Claremont Garments (Holdings) Plc said it is to close its factory in Glasgow.
It is expected the closure will result in the loss of about 700 jobs.
The company started talks with Britain's GMB union, the Scottish Office and the Glasgow Development Agency in September on the future of the Glasgow plant.
Claremont said in a statement, "Having considered all alternative options, it has not proved possible to establish any basis for a long term future for the company in the Glasgow area."
The company said it planned to keep as many staff on as possible between now and the end of the year while it "concludes necessary discussions with individuals and their representatives."

The company, which produces womens' clothing and lingerie mainly for Marks & Spencer Plc, announced a fundamental review of its business in March after 1995 pretax profits slipped to 12.9 million stg from 15 million.
